method: Live GitHub Contents/Trees API reads (gh CLI) plus a shallow git clone to a short path (C:/cpnet, to avoid Windows MAX_PATH issues) and real `dotnet build`/`dotnet run` (dotnet 10.0.401) against the actual src/ library and samples/ projects, plus a standalone console project exercising every Quick Start / Additional Examples snippet verbatim and reflecting over the built assembly's exported types.

facts.claim: Pure managed code, multi-targets netstandard2.0 and net8.0
facts.evidence: src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj: <TargetFrameworks>netstandard2.0;net8.0</TargetFrameworks>; `dotnet build src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj -c Debug` (the README's exact command) succeeded, producing both Aspose.Cells.FOSS.dll outputs (netstandard2.0 and net8.0).
csproj: <Version>26.9.0.0</Version>, matching the README's installation snippet exactly.

facts.claim: Public namespace is Aspose.Cells_FOSS (underscore), distinct from the NuGet package id Aspose.Cells.FOSS (dots)
facts.evidence: Reflected over the built assembly: typeof(Workbook).Namespace == "Aspose.Cells_FOSS"; package id in csproj PackageId/AssemblyName is Aspose.Cells.FOSS.

facts.claim: Quick Start 'create a workbook, write and format cells' snippet (PutValue, GetStyle/SetStyle, Font/FillPattern, Formula) works
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: README's first Quick Start snippet run verbatim, produced a 2531-byte products.xlsx with no exception; sheet.Cells["B4"].Formula read back as "=SUM(B2:B3)" (stored as string, not evaluated, consistent with the Scope section's no-calculation-engine claim).

facts.claim: LoadOptions{TryRepairPackage, TryRepairXml, StrictMode} and workbook.LoadDiagnostics.HasDataLossRisk work as documented
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: README's second Quick Start snippet run verbatim against the previously-saved products.xlsx; HasDataLossRisk read without exception (false, as expected for a clean file); re-save to updated.xlsx succeeded (2534 bytes).

facts.claim: PageSetup.PaperSize/Orientation plus Save(path, new PdfSaveOptions{OnePagePerSheet=true}) exports PDF
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: README's third Quick Start snippet run verbatim, produced a 20308-byte report.pdf; also ran the shipped samples/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.Samples.PdfConversion project unmodified via `dotnet run --project ...`, which converted samples/files/sample.xlsx to sample.pdf successfully.

facts.claim: Development and Testing section's exact `dotnet run --project samples\Aspose.Cells_FOSS.Samples.Basic\...` command runs
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: ran unmodified, printed Hello/Int32/Boolean/Decimal/DateTime/formula-result lines with no exception, confirming multi-type PutValue (string/int/bool/decimal/DateTime) and formula storage.

facts.claim: 'Build a Table With Totals' snippet (ListObjects.Add, TableStyleType, ShowTotals) works
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: snippet run verbatim, produced a 3270-byte products-table.xlsx with no exception.

facts.claim: API Reference table's listed classes/interfaces/structs/enums exist in the public surface (spot-checked: CellsException, FormulaException, UnsupportedFeatureException, StyleException, WorkbookLoadException, WorkbookSaveException, InvalidFileFormatException, IWarningCallback, CellArea, Color, LoadIssue, DiagnosticSeverity, ImageType, TargetModeType)
facts.evidence: Reflected over the built assembly's GetExportedTypes() (98 total exported types): all 14 spot-checked names found, all in namespace Aspose.Cells_FOSS as documented.

facts.claim: Cell.PutValue(value), PutValue(value, isConverted), PutValue(value, isConverted, setStyle) overloads exist
facts.evidence: Reflected over Cell type's methods named PutValue: overload parameter-counts found were {1,1,1,1,1,1,2,3,1} -- includes a 1-arg form (multiple, for different value types), a 2-arg form, and a 3-arg form, matching the three documented signatures.

facts.claim: Cell.Formula stores the formula as a string; library does not parse/evaluate/recalculate
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: after setting B4.Formula = "=SUM(B2:B3)" and saving/reading back, the value is the literal formula string, not a computed 4.98; no recalculation API was exercised or found in the reflected type surface.

facts.claim: Load support is limited to XLSX; legacy XLS is not loaded
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: wrote a file with the legacy OLE2/XLS magic bytes (D0 CF 11 E0 A1 B1 1A E1) and attempted new Workbook("fake.xls"); raised InvalidFileFormatException: 'The workbook is not a valid XLSX zip package.' -- consistent with the documented XLSX-only load scope.

facts.claim: All 15 sample project names listed under 'View All Sample Projects' exist as real .csproj files under samples/
facts.evidence: git tree listing at source_revision confirms all 15 named .csproj files exist under samples/, one per listed project name, plus src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj for the library itself.
